purpose: Adopted committed-source coverage, execution provenance and no-growth size enforcement for 140 legacy application files, the extracted curve kernel, project-document/project-entry integration, and the opacity application MCP slice. Complete architecture boundaries remain a separate gate.

scope.selection: Recursively enumerate committed paths beneath sourceRoot independently of profiles and this artifact, selecting exact case-sensitive suffixes in sourceKinds. Include .d.ts under .ts. Require regular files and reject aliases/symlinks rather than silently skipping them.
scope.pathConvention: Normalized repository-relative POSIX paths. Exact case-sensitive exclusions only: no globs, directory exemptions or inferred vendor/minified/generated exclusions.
scope.typeScript: The four current .ts matches are generated .d.ts declarations, each explicitly excluded. TS selection declares coverage responsibility, not checker parser support.
scope.outsideSelection: HTML is pinned as bootstrap evidence, including its inline script. CSS, JSON/package metadata, WASM binaries, other assets, Rust and sources outside src are outside this JS-family inventory. Imported network/plugin payloads are not committed source files.

inventoryDigest.serialization: Ascending POSIX path order; UTF-8 path + NUL + Git blob SHA-1 + LF for each selected path, including final LF; hash the concatenated bytes.

document-classic.timing: Parser-blocking tag without async/defer, evaluated in document order if reached. Script evaluation does not imply synchronous completion of callbacks, dynamic imports or initialization.

document-module.timing: type=module without async: deferred evaluation, not a synchronous barrier before later classic scripts. Async initialization completes separately.

module-worker.timing: On-demand Worker construction with type=module, outside document parser order.

classic-without-load-site.timing: Browser IIFE/Labs registration source retained for coverage. No committed bootstrap/import/worker load site found; no current execution claimed. Conditional feature behavior requires explicit loading and registration.

imported-module.timing: Static or dynamic imported helper, with importer/activation recorded per path; not an HTML classic-script entry.

type-declaration.timing: Non-executable generated declarations; no runtime load site.

bootstrapObservations.scriptOrdinalConvention: One-based order of all script start tags, including inline and excluded vendor tags.
bootstrapObservations.orderingLimit: Module tags do not establish synchronous readiness before the later classic engine-bridge.js tag. HTML order is not a complete global provider/consumer graph.
bootstrapObservations.runtimeLimit: Source-declared sites, not observed successful execution: gpu-gate.js may stop boot. No browser/Tauri/runtime acceptance is claimed.

noLoadSiteAudit.scope: All committed HTML and src JS-family sources at candidateCommit: local script URLs, imports, worker constructors and script injection inspected; Node test consumers are separate evidence.
noLoadSiteAudit.note: Labs manages registered prototypes and flags, not discovery/loading of omitted files. The stale HTML comment about reference-3d.js is superseded by its actual script tag.

coverageHelper.sourcePaths: Independently rediscover all selected committed candidate paths from scope, including exclusions. Never seed discovery from retainedSources, a profile or a baseline.
coverageHelper.exclusions: Project policy.exclusions to an exact string[] of record.path values.
coverageHelper.options: Only root, sourcePaths and exclusions are helper options. Validate policy version, provenance and execution metadata outside the helper.

integration.scriptOrderHelper: Use pinned HTML bytes and actual tag attributes. retainedSources[].loadSites records scriptOrdinal only for actual document entries. Worker/import edges and additional Node test contexts are separate from document parser order.
requiredChecks: Fresh committed inventory equals the disjoint union of retainedSources paths and exact exclusions, each occurring once. Reject new, missing, aliased or duplicate sources.
Retained paths and module IDs equal reviewed profile membership exactly.
Every exclusion exists as a selected regular source and retains justified provenance; verify artifact hashes and review changes.
Reconcile source/index/profile provenance and loader evidence on the actual integration candidate; snapshot counts do not replace fresh discovery.
